definitions: A temporary displacement of the regular metrical accent in music, caused by stressing a weak beat or an off-beat.
The practice of syncopating rhythmic patterns.
A shortening of a word by the omission of letters or syllables from the middle of the word.
examples: The jazz piece was full of complex syncopation.
He struggled to play the syncopation correctly.
The word 'ne'er' is an example of syncopation.
